subject.title: Slack Socket Mode events not reaching Gateway despite full config per documentation

question: Should this broader Slack Socket Mode report stay separate while awaiting diagnostics, or be folded into the open reaction-specific report once the reporter confirms reactions are the failing event family?
rationale: The public issue body lacks the attached report, while the related open report has concrete reaction-only steps; choosing the canonical path depends on evidence that is not in the public thread.

options.title: Keep Separate And Request Diagnostics
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broader Socket Mode report and ask for redacted `openclaw channels status --probe --json`, trace logs, event family, and raw envelope/drop-boundary evidence.

options.title: Fold Into Reaction-Specific Report
options.body: If the reporter confirms the missing report is only about Slack reaction events, treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56653 as the canonical live report and preserve this issue as linked context.

options.title: Wait For Stale Info Threshold
options.body: If no diagnostics arrive after the issue crosses the stale-insufficient-info age threshold, close with a request for a new report that includes reproducible current-main evidence.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate And Request Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broader Socket Mode report and ask for redacted `openclaw channels status --probe --json`, trace logs, event family, and raw envelope/drop-boundary evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The central uncertainty is in Slack monitor filtering and Socket Mode behavior, where history shows steipete as the heaviest contributor and a prior duplicate-close participant.
